candidate: Map-balanced pairwise linear head on root-conditioned post-turn material and economy features, fitted to complete terminal outcomes under persistent reply-search on both seats. Candidate states outside the actual top-eight completed-turn slate are excluded. Censored labels are excluded from pairwise fitting and reported in evaluation.
decision: Offline validation is exploratory. The full-game gate stays untouched until feature choice and weights are frozen. Compare the candidate against plain beam-256 and the reply-search teacher in complete games from both seats, grouped by independent map, with a wall-time benchmark. A stronger-than-plain-search claim requires a positive grouped-map result with two-sided exact sign-test p below 0.05 and no seat-specific significantly negative result. Claim cost-saving distillation only if the map-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound against the teacher is above minus 30 pool-relative Elo and median compute per move is less than half the teacher. Otherwise reject the candidate; do not rate or publish it.
